earlier_sources: https://github.com/librefonts/englebert at 0b03ab09eab75a39c93f8fb0432459a7dca74176: src/Englebert-Regular-TTF.vfb, a FontLab import of version 1.000. The release is version 1.010: the vertical metrics and the copyright were changed on the binary in google/fonts (056368350, b7f6aa926; December 2024), so no source of it exists.
disclose: The build's GSUB numbers or packs some lookups differently from the release's (fontc places a lookup that only a contextual lookup calls, and packs chained contextual rules, its own way: gfonts-ai-usage-report 22-fontc-problems, problems 12 and 13); every rule is the same and the text shapes identically (tools/functional_gate.py). Decided 2026-10-02: problems that need fontc are disclosed and fixed in fontc later.

The release's head table states version 1.010 (0x0001028F, its fontRevision) where the format allows only 1.0; the build states 1.0. It is the only font Google Fonts ships with another value (head_version_scan.py, google/fonts cc39c4c2c).
